footerText: Made with ❤️ and Miatas by Gio Coia
disclaimer: This tool is provided for informational purposes only. Fitment results are estimates — no guarantee is made about their accuracy. Always verify clearances and consult a professional before fitting wheels or tyres.
metaDescription: Finally, fix that wheel gap! Compare wheel and tyre fitment setups side by side — diameter, poke, speedo error, ride height and more.
subtitle: Wheel & Tyre Fitment Calculator
suspensionNote: Suspension shown is for illustrative purposes only.
canvasAriaLabelStatic: Cross-section diagram comparing current and new wheel and tyre setups
calcStatus: Fitment results calculated. Scroll down to view the comparison table and diagram.
canvasAriaLabelDynamic: Cross-section comparison: current setup {oDiameter} mm diameter, new setup {nDiameter} mm diameter. Current poke {oPoke} mm, new poke {nPoke} mm.
tipDiameter: Total outer diameter of the tyre from tread to tread (mm). A taller tyre increases this value.
tipCircumference: Total rolling circumference of the tyre (mm). Determines distance per wheel revolution — directly drives speedo accuracy.
tipPoke: How far the outer rim edge extends beyond the hub mounting face (mm). Positive = wheel pokes outward. Too much and the tyre fouls the arch.
tipInset: Distance from the inner rim lip to the hub mounting face — also called backspacing (mm). Too little and the wheel fouls inner suspension.
tipSpeedoError: How much the speedometer reads relative to actual speed with the new tyres. Negative = speedo under-reads (shows less than actual).
tipAt1: What your speedometer shows when actually doing 30 mph with the new tyres. A larger tyre means fewer revolutions and a lower speedo reading.
tipAt2: What your speedometer shows when actually doing 60 mph with the new tyres.
tipRideHeight: How much the car body rises due to the change in tyre radius (mm). Affects handling geometry and headlight aim.
tipArchGap: Reduction in clearance between outer tyre tread and wheel arch liner (mm). Positive = less gap — watch for rubbing on bumps.
warnSpeedoUnder: Speedometer will under-read — your true speed is higher than shown, which isn't road-legal in many regions.
warnSpeedoOver: Speedometer over-reads by more than 10% — it shows well above your true speed.
warnDiameter: Overall diameter changes by {pct}% — can affect the speedometer, ABS/traction control and clearance.
warnStretch: Tyre looks stretched for this rim width — raises the risk of the bead unseating.
warnBulge: Rim looks narrow for this tyre — the tread may bulge.
warnLowProfile: Very low-profile tyre — expect a harsher ride and a higher risk of wheel and pothole damage.
warnSpacer: Large wheel spacer — check that enough wheel-stud thread still engages and use hub-centric spacers.
warnCamber: Aggressive camber — accelerates inner-edge tyre wear and reduces the braking contact patch.
